Nothing in the model was changed (user decision A0). Reaction colour = scenario value: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 % on Task A + PO1f, uracil open, R612 closed; Gurobi 1e-9). What-if scenarios are in-memory tests that were NOT implemented.

Node colour (Task A, whole-model FVA): orange = every reaction blocked as built and in the C' what-if; blue = every reaction blocked as built, not in the what-if; grey = has an unblocked reaction. Repeated nodes are the same pool. Layout is automatic.
AS BUILT: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 %), Task A + PO1f. Every UM2 reaction is 0
